name: kalide-rename
body: source: user decision to rename the product "ey-present"/"eypres" to "kalide" (Kalón + Slide), hard cut, no backward compat — repo git@github.com:really-knows-ai/kalide.git; module github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide; binary `kalide` (cmd/kalide, assets kalide-<os>-<arch>); config `kalide.yaml` (eypres.yaml not recognised); env KALIDE_* (EYPRES_* not read); Formula/kalide.rb, bucket/kalide.json, tap really-knows-ai/kalide, bucket "kalide". inconsistency: spec nodes named and described the old product/repo/module/binary/config names. resolution: (1) added requirements.requirement.kalide-rename (feature=distribution, contained by distribution; drives domain.group.distribution and domain.value.deck-config) capturing the decisions with AC; (2) renamed FQNs, recreating every edge: solution.system.eypres → solution.system.kalide, domain.service.install-eypres → domain.service.install-kalide, requirements.stakeholder.eypres-maintainers → requirements.stakeholder.kalide-maintainers, solution.note.fix-eypres-template-source → solution.note.fix-kalide-template-source; (3) rewrote bodies of all current-truth requirement/domain/solution/global nodes and fact-stating notes to the new names. Historical fix-* notes (e.g. fix-validation-order, fix-deck-config-keys, fix-graceful-shutdown, fix-native-e2e-definition, fix-single-binary-targets, reconcile-implemented-by-reusable-templates, fix-component-implemented-by, domain fix-deck-changed-templates-scope) are left verbatim because they quote past source statements. DEFERRED to plan time: all implemented-by edges still target current code FQNs under go.github.com/really-knows-ai/ey-present/... plus files examples/demo/eypres.yaml and Formula/eypres.rb (solution components template-library-loader, file-watcher, cli-commands, init-seed, templates-gallery, http-server, template-registry, deck-validator, renderer, theme-registry, native-e2e-ci, deck-loader, demo-fixture, homebrew-formula). They were NOT re-pointed because the kalide FQNs do not resolve yet; the plan-writer must declare planned go.github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide/... / examples/demo/kalide.yaml / Formula/kalide.rb (and bucket/kalide.json, cmd/kalide) FQNs and re-point these edges. [with user]
